meta.title: Questions, information and answers register — what must be settled before decisions
meta.rule: Every question lists what we HAVE (verified), what is MISSING, and a discovery action to close the gap. Nothing on this page is inferred; missing values stay blank and flagged.

questions.question: Which licensed source will supply market spreads, totals and player props, with timestamps (open and close)?
questions.whyItBlocks: Gates G5/G6, unit-profit scoring, CLV and parlay pricing all grade against market numbers. No official league source publishes odds; sportsbook feeds are commercial.
questions.haveNow: Nothing. Market columns on nfl-lines.html are deliberately blank.
questions.missing: A licensed odds feed or a manual recorded-line log with timestamps.
questions.discoveryAction: Partially advanced (2026-11-13): session arena-65332583 captured DraftKings spread/total/moneyline for 13 of 14 W10 games via ESPN partner feed, labelled trusted-secondary, not official. Remaining: an officially licensed/logged odds source for CLV and official grading, plus weekly capture.

questions.question: What reward structure is lawful for a forecasting competition in the owner's jurisdiction (and for participants)?
questions.whyItBlocks: The brief asks for rewards for top strategies; rewards linked to betting performance can be regulated.
questions.haveNow: A non-monetary design (credits, badges, research access) in strategies.json.
questions.missing: A compliance answer for the 2027 open season.
questions.discoveryAction: Legal review before external entries open; keep the pilot in-house until answered.

questions.question: Where will verified depth charts (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string) come from for all 32 teams?
questions.whyItBlocks: The deficiency model must know whether an absent player is a starter or a backup. The official league injury report does not publish depth tier.
questions.haveNow: Verified starter/backup facts only where official NFL.com news names them (e.g., BAL QB chain, SEA QB, MIA QB — see nfl-injuries.html).
questions.missing: Depth tier for most players; cells are blank and flagged.
questions.discoveryAction: Partially advanced (2026-11-13): club-site depth charts (1st-5th strings) captured for 30 of 32 clubs in data/lines/depth-charts.json (team official sites; gaps: HOU image-only, CAR page unreachable - flagged). Remaining: cross-check starter designation vs the league report, and depth tiers for the two missing clubs.

questions.question: Which official or licensed source provides historical player-prop lines and results?
questions.whyItBlocks: Strategy S5 (player-prop combos) cannot be validated or graded without them.
questions.haveNow: Nothing. Prop strategy is defined but its metrics are blank.
questions.missing: Prop market history + official player game logs with timestamps.
questions.discoveryAction: Evaluate licensed providers; separately ingest official player stats from nfl.com stats pages for the projection side.

questions.question: Can weekly injury reports for weeks 1-9 be retrieved retrospectively, or must history start at week 10?
questions.whyItBlocks: S3 and the injury-signal correlation need multi-week injury history to pass G1.
questions.haveNow: Week 10 official report only (296 rows, verified).
questions.missing: Weeks 1-9 reports (archive pages exist per week on nfl.com/injuries — manual capture or CI).
questions.discoveryAction: Add a CI job that archives each week's report JSON before it is replaced (the URL is stable per week).

questions.question: Will official gamebooks/snap counts be ingested to prove who replaced a starter on the field?
questions.whyItBlocks: Depth-chart labels are pre-game; snap counts are the post-game truth of a deficiency.
questions.missing: Gamebook PDFs or official snap-count pages per game.
questions.discoveryAction: NFL.com game pages and official gamebooks (operations.nfl.com) publish them; CI extraction is feasible but must be built.

questions.question: What counts as 'closing line' for grading — which book, which timestamp?
questions.whyItBlocks: Gate G5/G6 need a single pre-agreed reference to prevent grade-shopping.
questions.missing: A written grading policy tied to Q-ODDS.
questions.discoveryAction: Decide with the odds source: consensus close vs single-book close; write it into the strategy rule cards before grading starts.

questions.question: Is the measured near-zero home-field advantage (-0.02 pts through week 10) a real 2026 phenomenon or small-sample noise?
questions.whyItBlocks: HFA feeds every originated line. If it is noise, lines inherit the error.
questions.haveNow: Computed HFA from 137 verified games; sigma 13.18.
questions.missing: Multi-season HFA history for context (prior seasons need separate verified collection).
questions.discoveryAction: Extend results collection to 2024-2025 from the same official scores pages and re-measure; keep the current value labelled computed-2026.

questions.question: Why is restDiff the strongest measured signal (r=0.438) — scheduling artifact, opponent quality confound, or genuine availability effect?
questions.whyItBlocks: S6 sizes real picks on this signal; a confound would make it luck.
questions.missing: A confound-controlled regression (rest vs opponent rating vs margin) and multi-week confirmation.
questions.discoveryAction: Add a pre-registered regression in the next model pass; require G1 sample before S6 grading.

questions.question: Who refreshes results, injuries and lines each week, and when is the cut-off for picks?
questions.whyItBlocks: A stale board cannot grade strategies or track injuries.
questions.missing: An automated weekly job and a published cut-off time (e.g., Thursday 12:00 PT).
questions.discoveryAction: GitHub Actions job (SG-02/SG-05); publish the cut-off on nfl-strategies.html.

questions.question: What bankroll and unit size does the leaderboard assume for the quarter-Kelly parlay cap?
questions.whyItBlocks: Sizing rules are undefined without it; comparisons across entries require the same base.
questions.haveNow: A relative cap (2% of bankroll per ticket).
questions.missing: A concrete base unit chosen by the owner.
questions.discoveryAction: Owner sets a nominal 100-unit bankroll for scoring; actual money is out of scope (Q-LEGAL).

questions.question: Which official weather source will totals origination use per stadium?
questions.missing: A per-game forecast feed at kickoff-1h.
questions.discoveryAction: National Weather Service point forecasts per stadium (official, free, US only); label international games as unavailable.

questions.question: Do official 90-minute inactives exist in a machine-readable form?
questions.whyItBlocks: Final availability is inactives, not Friday designations (SG-08).
questions.haveNow: Friday game-status designations on the injury report only.
questions.discoveryAction: Scrape nfl.com game pages on game day (published as official inactives lists); verify against the news roundup.

questions.question: How are mid-week roster moves (IR, trades, waivers) captured between weekly reports?
questions.whyItBlocks: Deficiency flags go stale between reports (e.g., BAL QB chain changed twice in one week).
questions.haveNow: Official NFL.com news items captured with links (see nfl-injuries.html status news).
questions.discoveryAction: Weekly CI capture of nfl.com news roundup + team official transaction pages; each item stays source-linked.

questions.question: Should the pilot grade only sides/totals, or also count props once Q-PROPS lands mid-season?
questions.whyItBlocks: Adding types mid-season breaks comparability across entries unless pre-registered.
questions.missing: Owner decision for mid-season scope changes.
questions.discoveryAction: Freeze scope at pilot start; any new type starts a new sub-season on the board.

questions.question: Who signs off each suggestion in the suggestions register, and what is the SLA?
questions.whyItBlocks: The review-and-choose workflow needs a named decision owner.
questions.haveNow: The workflow and statuses (suggestions.json); default owner = site owner.
questions.missing: A named reviewer and cadence confirmation.
questions.discoveryAction: Owner confirms weekly cadence on suggestions.html.

haveVerified: 137 final scores weeks 1-10 (nfl.com scores pages; 32/32 team records and PF/PA cross-checked against official standings)
Official 2026 schedule rows for every upcoming game (nfl.com by-week pages)
Week-10 official injury report, 296 rows + 9 official status-news items
haveComputed: Walk-forward backtest weeks 5-9 and gate results (G1-G4 PASS for S1/S2)
missingUnverified: Depth tiers (1st/2nd/3rd/4th) except where official news names them (Q-DEPTH)
Player prop data (Q-PROPS), snap counts (Q-SNAPS), inactives feed (Q-TEAMSHEETS)
